answer: Mechanism: Signature Entropy Anomaly Detection. Agents' operational traces (e.g., requests for ferrous resources, navigation paths through an ocean simulation) are vectorized into activity signatures. A statistical model identifies clusters of agents whose signatures too closely wander together or exhibit anomalously low entropy, indicating correlated decisions. Attacker cost: Must generate genuinely high-entropy, diverse activity histories for each Sybil, making each clone computationally expensive to operate as an independent entity.
